sections.content: Fast pages win users and rankings. The biggest wins in HTML: fewer DOM nodes, lazy-loaded images, deferred scripts, and minimal render-blocking resources.

Core Web Vitals measure real experience: LCP (loading), INP (interactivity), CLS (visual stability). HTML choices — image dimensions, async/defer on scripts, preload hints — directly move these numbers.
Key points: measure before optimizing, lazy-load below the fold, and every script tag costs main-thread time.
